findings.title: Out-of-order stats responses: an older, slower response overwrites the newer range
findings.expected: After changing From to 2025-01-01 and then quickly to 2026-07-01, the page shows stats for 1 Jul 2026 - 31 Dec 2026
findings.actual: The From field says 2026-07-01 but the page shows '6 harvests from 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Dec 2026' and that range's table, because the delayed first response arrived last and won

findings.title: Malformed or unexpected stats response crashes the page and leaves it stuck on 'Loading stats...'
findings.expected: A visible error when the stats response is malformed or empty, and no uncaught error
findings.actual: Uncaught TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')'; the page stays on 'Loading stats...' with the old table and shows no error

findings.title: Clearing To with a From date after this year gives a misleading 'From must be on or before To' error
findings.expected: An empty To date is either accepted as an open end or refused with a reason about the empty field
findings.actual: With From=2027-03-01 and To empty, the server quietly uses 2026-12-31 as To and the page says 'The From date must be on or before the To date.', while still showing the old '5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026' line

findings.title: Months with no harvests are left out of the per-month table
findings.expected: The table has a column for every month in the chosen range (or at least between the first and last harvest), so gaps show up as empty months
findings.actual: The columns go straight from AUG 2025 to JUN 2026; Sep 2025 to May 2026 are missing, so the table looks like those months are next to each other

findings.title: After a failed load, the old range summary stays next to the error
findings.expected: When loading a new range fails, only the error shows, or the summary matches the selected range
findings.actual: From is 2025-01-01 but the page shows '5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026' just above the error
